name: ASCII Hover Button
title: ASCII Hover Button
description: Interactive button and segmented pill control featuring smooth color transitions and real-time ASCII cipher character scramble glitch on hover.
summary: An engineered interactive button and segmented pill tab group designed with an authentic ASCII cipher scramble glitch effect powered by GSAP. Smoothly shifts typography color and luminescence on hover while dynamically scrambling characters through a curated matrix of ASCII glyphs with zero layout jitter, complete dark and light mode synchronization, and full arbitrary color customization.
highlights: Hardware-accelerated GSAP progress tween driving real-time ASCII glyph scrambles
Individual character ghost layout slots guaranteeing zero pixel shifts or font metrics jitter
Smooth text luminescence and color morphing across dark and light color spaces
Includes AsciiSegmentedGroup pill container with fluid spring sliding layout indicator
Seven preset neon and gemstone palettes plus arbitrary hex/rgb color overrides
Accessible keyboard navigation with Arrow navigation, TabIndex, and aria-selected support
Respects prefers-reduced-motion media query for seamless accessibility
anatomy: <motion.div> (Sliding active pill indicator with spring physics)
<AsciiGlitchText> (Core text primitive with invisible sizer and scrambling glyph overlay)

physics.engine: GSAP Core Tween & Motion Spring Physics
physics.description: Progressive character resolution curve driven by GSAP power2.out tween combined with spring layout physics.

accessibility.aria: Applies role='tablist' and role='tab' for segmented groups with proper aria-selected and aria-label attributes.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Bypasses ASCII glyph scramble and renders target text immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

keyboard.description: Cycle through segmented options with auto-selection.
Focus active tab or standalone button with visible focus ring.

recommended: Timeframe selectors (1D, 7D, 1M, 1Y, ALL) in analytics, crypto, and finance charts
High-tech call-to-action triggers on developer tools, AI platforms, and cyberpunk aesthetics
Segmented view switchers and category filters in modern dark-mode applications
bestPractices: Pair with monospace or clean geometric sans-serif fonts for optimal aesthetic cohesion
Use preset colors or vibrant custom colors that maintain high contrast in both dark and light modes
Keep text concise (1-16 characters) for snappy visual impact

props.description: Active and hover text accent color preset or custom hex string.

props.description: Visual surface style for standalone buttons.

props.name: scrambleDuration
